example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সকল প্রচেষ্টা ধূলিসাৎ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: All his efforts turned to dust.
The army's strategy was completely reduced to dust in the war.
note: This idiom metaphorically conveys total annihilation or failure, rooted in the imagery of something valuable being reduced to worthless dust.
